name: smallnorb
description: smallNORB is a classic computer-vision dataset for 3D object recognition and pose-generalization. It contains stereo image pairs of toy objects across different elevations, azimuths, and lighting conditions, and is commonly used to evaluate object classification and pose estimation robustness. The dataset is often used for representation learning and view-invariant recognition experiments.
evaluation_method: accuracy (for classification) and pose-error metrics for pose estimation
reputation: Well-known, classic benchmark in the vision community for 3D object recognition and view-invariant representation learning.
